## Memory (gen2)

## State
- gen1 (r1-r16): accepted E0001 JoinDependent rule order (q19), E0002 contains() selectivity (q09), E0003 perfect HJ RIGHT (q13), E0005 BF first key multi-key HJ (q09), E0006 key-set range filter through compress projs (q18), E0007 exact bitmap BF, E0011 semi-join estimate, E0012 OR-of-ranges mask, E0014 FSST simple decode + substring prefilter (q13), E0016 DELIM_GET-build BF (q22 -20%). Best 1.281x.
- gen2 r1+r2: E0017/E0018 (no CM on hash-join keys) RETIRED twice: hidden validation regressed. DEAD.
- gen2 r5: E0021 = E0019 (deliminate SEMI) + E0020 (exact BF through CM offset) ACCEPTED.
- gen2 r6: E0022 exact-BF small-range floor ACCEPTED (-9.9%).
- gen2 r7: E0023 ANTI deliminator ACCEPTED.
- gen2 r8: E0024 parallel perfect-HJ build + INNER dense <=4M ACCEPTED.
- gen2 r11: E0027 BitPacking per-value select + exact BF to 2^27 ACCEPTED.
- gen2 r13: E0029 = E0028 sparse perfect-HJ exact BF + fixed 8-byte BitPacking extract ACCEPTED (-2.5%).
- gen2 r14: fallback block cache alone RETIRED (geomean -1.6%, no template beyond noise).
- gen2 r15: E0031 = block cache (256MB cap) + large perfect HA v3 ACCEPTED: q13 -25%, geomean -4.5%. Best 1.800x.
- gen2 r16: DISPATCHED faster substring search (rare-pair anchors + exact multi-literal LIKE in prefilter), aimed at the q13 orders scan (1.72s CPU).
- Claude auto-memory (~/.claude/.../memory) holds results from a PREVIOUS evolve run. Treat them as strong priors.

## Resident-memory agg slowdown (r14/r15)
- Cause: jemalloc per-block alloc/free of 256KB blocks slows once arenas are shared with many long-lived blocks. The 256MB LIFO reuse cache in BlockAllocator fixes it; 64MB was not enough after the large perfect HA landed.
- read_csv can read /sys files; /proc reads as empty.

## Acceptance lessons
- Acceptance needs BOTH: some template faster beyond its noise AND a visible geomean that improves. Any template slower beyond noise gets the issue retired.
- Bundling a near-miss with a second mechanism on the same template works (E0021, E0027, E0029). Bundling a near-miss with the fix for its blocker also works (E0031).

## q13 current plan (r16 profile, 373ms)
- orders scan + NOT LIKE '%unusual%packages%' 1.72s CPU. The prefilter needle is 'packages' (the longest literal); FindSubstring anchors on its first/last chars 'p'/'s' (common) + memcmp (column_segment.cpp:665).
- RIGHT perfect HJ 0.29s; decompress->compress projection pair 0.24s CPU (the fold was tried before: HA slowed on unflattened input; it might differ now with the large HA); large PERFECT_HASH_GROUP_BY 0.95s on 15.3M rows (~62ns/row, per-thread 1.5M-slot tables, likely cache misses).

## Codebase facts
- Perfect HJ BF: CanUseBloomFilter + PushPerfectHashJoinBloomFilters (physical_hash_join.cpp); PerfectHashJoinExecutor::FillExactBloomFilter.
- BitPacking: bitpacking.cpp (Select ~886, per-value when sel*4<=count). DELTA_FOR still decodes everything.
- TEMP tables are never compressed.
- Substring prefilter: column_segment.cpp:662-860 (GetSubstringPrefilter picks the longest literal; TrySubstringPrefilter searches runs).
- Radix agg memory: radix_partitioned_hashtable.cpp GetThreadLimit :163. BlockAllocator: block_allocator.cpp.
- CM: src/optimizer/compressed_materialization*. Deliminator: deliminator.cpp. Join filters: join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp. Perfect HA: plan_aggregate.cpp + physical_perfecthash_aggregate.cpp.

## How to measure
- Micro A/B: CREATE TEMP VIEW a/b; alternate them in one dbe-tool sql call (each call is a new process).
- Full operator timings: SET enable_profiling='json'; profiling_output under the slot's .dbe/.
- Bench noise thresholds: q16 ~7.9%, q18 ~5%, q13 ~14%, q09 ~8.6%, q14 ~5.1%, q05 ~20%, q04 ~20%, q07 ~13%.

## Profile snapshot (r16): q18 551, q09 396, q13 373, q05 199, q03 181, q16 174, q07 161, q08 159, q04 144, q17 116, q22 108, q14 108, q19 93, q02 55. Geomean 166.8.

## Dead / exhausted
- CM join-key removal, HJ prefetch, agg run-collapse, in-place finalize, FSST heap reuse, dictionary filter, scan filter cost ordering, early HT grow, sparse perfect HJ (8M range), hashed BF through CM offset, q13 eager aggregation, fused hashed BF probe, allocator flush thresholds. CM fold decompress/compress was retired before the large HA existed; it may be worth one retest.

## Next candidates (next gen)
1. q13: CM fold retest on top of the large HA (0.24s CPU projection pair); large-HA locality (radix-partition the input by key before the per-thread tables).
2. Large HJ builds (q09 o_orderkey 1.37s, q07 0.48s): a partitioned build is too big for one round.
3. q18 (551ms, the largest template): no open idea; re-profile its agg/HJ split first.
